segments.text: 20 The name of God be prayſed for euer and euer, for wiſdome and ſtrength are his.
21 And he changeth the times and ſeaſons, hee taketh away kynges and he ſetteth vp kynges, he geueth wiſedome vnto the wiſe and vnderſtanding to thoſe that vnderſtand.
22 He diſcouereth the deepe and ſecret thinges: he knoweth what is in darkenes. &c.
